title: Radar incursions over northern US missile warning system
summary: Karl Nell tells of Radar incursions over northern US missile warning system, about 1970s at United States (no place named), and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: incursions over the northern us ballistic missile warning system in the 70s where uh Radars were picking up UFOs

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, a guest named Karl Nell says that in the 1970s, radars in the northern US ballistic missile warning system, the network that watches for incoming nuclear missiles, picked up UFOs crossing into its airspace. If true, it would mean unknown objects were flying near some of the country's most sensitive defenses.
